Jet HR ha fornito un livello di retribuzione Questo livello è fornito da Jet HR. La tua retribuzione effettiva sarà basata sulle tue competenze e la tua esperienza. Rivolgiti al tuo recruiter per saperne di più. Livello retribuzione di base 45.000,00 €/yr - 60.000,00 €/anno Who we are We're a startup founded in 2023 by serial entrepreneurs: Marco Ogliengo and Francesco Scalambrino have already built successful companies and HR software for unicorn businesses. We closed the largest pre-seed round ever raised in Italy (€4.7M) , backed by some of the sharpest entrepreneurs in tech. A year later we closed a €12M seed round , and in June 2025 we closed a further €25M round , led by US VC Base10, which picked us for its very first deal in Italy. Italy is known as the land of red tape. That red tape is one of the acknowledged reasons the Italian economy is stuck. Jet's mission? Erase bureaucracy from Italian firms . What is bureaucracy, exactly? Hours spent decoding regulations, filling in forms, waiting for approvals and fixing the inevitable human errors. Jet is the answer: a single platform that simplifies and automates the entire admin side of an Italian company. It's obvious that the future can't stay this slow and clunky: with Jet we're pulling that future forward, and we have a real shot at becoming the default operative system of Italian companies. We hate bureaucracy: let's go kill it. What you'll do Explore and optimise paid channels. You'll run and improve campaigns across Google, Meta, LinkedIn and new paid channels. You’ll manage campaigns and creatives to drive CAC down. Relentless automation . The old ways of running paid campaigns aren't enough anymore. You'll be on the front line of automating your own work and building new tools to make it more efficient. Optimise the acquisition funnel . Landing pages, follow-ups, retargeting: your scope doesn't stop at capturing leads, but goes all the way to signing deals. What we're looking for At least 2 years of experience in Paid Marketing B2B. You've profitably managed budgets in the tens or hundreds of thousands in channels like Google, Meta, and LinkedIn. At least 1 year of experience in SEO, preferably B2B, is a plus . You've grown other products several times over through organic SEO. You know your way around link building, authority, and AEO. Entrepreneurial obsession. You know (or want to learn) exactly who our prospects are and what their biggest problems look like. You understand how they think, how they work, and how to reach them. An experimental, analytical approach . You need to be able to separate the background noise from real learnings. You know how to set up rigorous A/B tests and identify what actually works in highly complex environments. An impact-driven mindset. You understand how every part of your job affects conversions, pipeline and ARR generated. You spot bottlenecks and problems worth solving without needing constant input. You avoid perfectionism. A taste for hackish solutions. We're not looking for an engineer, but for someone who can move easily across automation tools, different data sources and integrations between systems. It takes curiosity, initiative and the autonomy to explore new technologies and solve technical problems yourself. Your ability to learn fast and adapt to change will be essential to succeeding in this role. Creativity and an eye for copy and design . You've produced creatives and copy that significantly lifted conversions and performance. You don’t just create something that looks nice: you know how to communicate our brand and the product's value to create actual conversions. What we offer €45,000 to €60,000 gross annual salary. Real impact. We're a startup, so everyone makes an essential contribution to Jet's growth. Our revenues will be a direct result of your work, and you'll have a major impact on the company's bottom line. Ownership . We expect you to go from idea to execution on your own. You own the final output. You'll be responsible for building our acquisition machines from zero to hundreds of thousands of clients. Start-up environment. Not just any startup, but a well-funded one packed with talent. In 6 months you'll see and learn things that elsewhere might take years, with a very high level of responsibility and involvement. Hybrid work. Our office is in Milan and we do expect you in, but with flexibility. We're not sticklers - we run on common sense. We’re open to discuss fully-remote work. Segnala offerta di lavoro Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da WeHunt Renata Caruso Renata Caruso Head Hunter - Practice Leader - Sales&Marketing Marketing Manager | Communication & Public Affairs Per un’importante associazione di categoria, siamo alla ricerca di un/una Marketing Manager con una forte sensibilità verso la comunicazione istituzionale, le relazioni esterne e le attività di Public Affairs. La persona entrerà in un contesto dinamico e fortemente relazionale, con l’obiettivo di sviluppare e consolidare il network dell’Associazione, rafforzandone il posizionamento e la visibilità nei confronti degli stakeholder di riferimento. La figura si occuperà di: definire e implementare le strategie di marketing e comunicazione dell’Associazione; sviluppare attività di comunicazione istituzionale, valorizzando il posizionamento e la reputazione dell’organizzazione; presidiare e sviluppare le relazioni con gli stakeholder istituzionali, associazioni, enti e principali interlocutori del settore; supportare le attività di Public Affairs, contribuendo alla costruzione e al consolidamento di relazioni con Ministeri, Pubblica Amministrazione e altre istituzioni rilevanti; sviluppare e ampliare il network relazionale dell’Associazione, creando opportunità di confronto, collaborazione e rappresentanza; coordinare attività ed eventi istituzionali, incontri con stakeholder e iniziative di networking; elaborare contenuti e strumenti di comunicazione rivolti agli associati e agli interlocutori esterni; monitorare il contesto di riferimento e i principali trend e temi di interesse per il settore, traducendoli in opportunità di comunicazione e posizionamento; collaborare con il management e con gli organi associativi nella definizione delle principali attività di relazione e comunicazione. Il/la candidato/a ideale possiede: esperienza maturata in ruoli di Marketing, Communication, Public Affairs o External Relations, in realtà caratterizzate da una forte componente istituzionale e relazionale; ottime capacità di networking e relationship management; comprovata capacità di interfacciarsi con interlocutori di alto livello, sia aziendali sia istituzionali; eccellenti capacità comunicative e relazionali, unite a una forte capacità di rappresentanza; autonomia, capacità organizzativa e approccio proattivo; ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro About the Role: If you are passionate about understanding shopper behavior and turning insights into business growth, this role offers the opportunity to make a real impact on Ferrero’s Beverage & Chilled categories. As a Shopper Marketing Manager , you will drive category growth by analyzing shopper trends, market dynamics, and category performance. Working closely with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Marketing teams, you will transform insights into strategies that strengthen our brands and create value for both shoppers and customers. Main Responsibilities: You will identify growth opportunities by analyzing shopper behaviors, consumption trends, and market evolution across channels and store formats. You will develop business recommendations to support innovation, category expansion, and product launches, while contributing to sales forecasting and performance reviews. You will work closely with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Marketing teams to define category growth strategies, support assortment and innovation plans, and deliver Category Management projects with key customers. You will also collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and successful execution of strategic priorities. About You: You bring a Master’s degree in Economics, Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field, along with some years of experience in Marketing, Trade & Shopper Marketing, Customer Management, or Shopper Insights roles, ideally within the FMCG industry. You bring a strong understanding of shopper behaviors and category dynamics, combined with solid analytical skills and experience working with Nielsen, IRI, and consumer research data. Your ability to turn insights into actions helps drive business growth and stronger customer engagement. You are comfortable working with digital tools and business applications, including advanced Excel and the Microsoft Office suite, and you communicate fluently in Italian and English. You bring curiosity, creativity, proactivity, and adaptability, together with a collaborative mindset and the ability to build effective relationships across teams. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape the future of our Beverage & Chilled categories. If you are looking for a dynamic environment where you can influence business decisions and drive category growth, apply now and become part of our journey. What We Offer: The role is classified at Level Quadro 1S under the National Collective Agreement for the Food Industry (CCNL Industria Alimentare). The guaranteed minimum base annual gross salary established by the CCNL for the applicable level is € 50.083. The compensation package also includes an annual variable component with a target of up to 10% of base salary. The overall compensation will be determined based on the experience, skills, and qualifications of the selected candidate. Careers with caring built in - discover our benefits here. About Ferrero: Ferrero began its journey in the small town of Alba in Piedmont, Italy, in 1946. Today, it is one of the world’s largest sweet-packaged food companies, with many iconic brands sold in countries all over the world. Find out more about Ferrero at ferrero.com. DE&I at Ferrero: Ferrero is committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture in which all employees feel welcomed and appreciated and have the same opportunities. We believe all our people are equally talented in their own way. In nurturing the curiosity and natural abilities of our employees, we provide them, generation after generation, the means to succeed personally and professionally, enabling them to craft their journey at Ferrero. The diversity of our talents is what makes our work environment multicultural, innovative, and highly rewarding. Find out more here.
